subject: BlueHaven onboarding: purchase-key assignation & spend-band correction
content:
Message 1/5
Date: Fri, 15 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
From: Carlos Mendes <carlos@bluehaven.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: procurement@bluehaven.com
Subject: BlueHaven onboarding: initial forms + requested provisional PO

Hi Monica,

Thanks for the quick intro earlier. Attached is our completed vendor onboarding packet and the signed W-9 (PDF). We're kicking off a 30-day pilot next week and need a provisional purchase key/PO to route the first invoices — initial spend expected to be ~$12k, then monthly thereafter.

Two quick notes from our side:
- On the product lines we submitted, line B ("Inference GPU credits") currently references your internal SKU 45-INV. On our billing sheet the item is split between "Compute credit" and "Support add-on" which makes it look like two separate line items. Can you confirm how you'd like those mapped to a single PO line?
- We requested an initial spend band of $25k to cover the pilot plus ramp. If procurement needs documentation to justify the temporary higher cap I can loop in our finance contact.

Attachment: BlueHaven_onboarding_form.pdf (application/pdf)

Appreciate the help — let me know what you need to get the PO out.

Best,
Carlos Mendes
Head of Partnerships
BlueHaven Systems

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.inference.com>

Cc: Carlos Mendes <carlos@bluehaven.com>
Subject: RE: BlueHaven onboarding: initial forms + requested provisional PO

Karthik / Connor — tagging you both to get procurement/finance eyes on BlueHaven's packet. Carlos attached the onboarding PDF. They asked for a provisional PO/purchase-key to route the pilot invoices (~$12k expected now, asking for a $25k spend band temporarily).

Karthik: can procurement provision a purchase-key and a provisional PO number? We should confirm how to map their two billing lines into our single PO line (we usually collapse compute/support into one code for new vendors during pilots).

Connor: if finance is comfortable with a $25k provisional spend band for a 30-day pilot, please confirm and advise whether we need a formal approval path (finance sign-off / exec approval). If not, what's the maximum provisional spend we can permit without additional approvals?

Goal: provide them a PO key today so they can bill for the first week of trial.

Thanks — Monica
Monica Patel | Account Exec, Platform Sales

Message 3/5
Date: Fri, 15 May 2026 13:27:00 -07:00
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.inference.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Carlos Mendes <carlos@bluehaven.com>
Subject: RE: BlueHaven onboarding: initial forms + requested provisional PO

Monica / Connor / Carlos —

I've reviewed the onboarding packet. We can provision a purchase-key and issue a provisional PO for the pilot, but we need to reconcile the line-item mapping before final issuance. Observations:

1) BlueHaven's form lists two rows that we should collapse into a single PO line on our side (SKU 45-INV). I'll issue the PO with a consolidated description but need written confirmation from BlueHaven that they will submit invoices referencing the consolidated line (not split).

2) Regarding spend band: procurement's default provisional cap for pilots is $15k without CFO approval. To approve $25k we need a brief finance justification (email thread is fine) or an approval from the finance lead.

If BlueHaven confirms consolidation of the two billing line items and Connor signs off on $25k provisional or an alternate amount, I'll create the purchase-key (PUR-K-20260515-842) and a tentative PO (PO-2026-05-842). I will mark it provisional and add a note for audit: "Pilot cap; subject to final invoicing reconciliation."

Next steps: Carlos to confirm invoice mapping; Connor to confirm cap.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.inference.com

Message 4/5
Date: Fri, 15 May 2026 15:05:00 -07:00
From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.inference.com>

Cc: Carlos Mendes <carlos@bluehaven.com>
Subject: RE: BlueHaven onboarding: initial forms + requested provisional PO

Monica / Karthik / Carlos —

Finance can approve a temporary $20k provisional cap for a 30-day pilot without needing CFO signature, provided we receive an updated invoice mapping and a short note from the vendor confirming how they'll reference the consolidated line (as Karthik noted). If BlueHaven needs $25k we will need a one-page justification from their finance team or an internal escalation to the VP of Finance.

I've attached the ledger snippet showing the GL codes we will use. Please re-submit invoices referencing the consolidated description and SKU 45-INV, and ensure the invoice totals do not exceed $20,000 under this provisional PO.

Attachment: ledger_snippet.csv (text/csv)

Connor O'Brien
Financial Operations Analyst
Redwood Inference
